[1] 21 CFR 820.10(c) requires manufacturers of class II, class III, and class I devices listed in paragraph (c)(1) and table 1 to compliance with Design and Development, Clause 7.3 and its Subclauses in ISO 13485. It applies only to devices in class I, II, and III.  
[2] 21 CFR 820.10(d) requires manufacturers of devices that support or sustain life to comply with Traceability for Implantable Devices, Clause 7.5.9.2 in ISO 13485, in addition to all other applicable requirements in this part, as appropriate.  

They differ in that 21 CFR 820.10(c) applies to devices in class I, II, and III, while 21 CFR 820.10(d) applies to devices that support or sustain life. Both provisions require compliance with ISO 13485, but 21 CFR 820.10(d) applies to devices that support or sustain life, which may have a higher risk of causing injury.
